productOverview.headline: Precision Agriculture Meets GIS Analysis
productOverview.description: The DJI Mavic 3 Multispectral combines an RGB camera with a four-band multispectral sensor, enabling NDVI mapping, crop health monitoring, and environmental impact analysis in a single flight.

keyFeatures.headline: Key Features
keyFeatures.description: Sensor capabilities built for agricultural and environmental survey work.

items.title: Four Multispectral Bands
items.description: Green (560 nm), Red (650 nm), Red Edge (730 nm), Near Infrared (860 nm).

items.title: 20 MP RGB Sensor
items.description: High-resolution RGB imagery for accurate orthomosaics.

items.title: NDVI Mapping
items.description: Generates NDVI maps for crop health and soil moisture variability analysis.

items.title: GIS-Ready Outputs
items.description: Exports NDVI maps and GeoTIFF raster layers compatible with ArcGIS, QGIS, and Google Earth Engine.
